$comment: A control on glass (toolkit/CONTRACT.md, 'Floating control capsule'): how it answers its
backdrop, the washes of its states and the inks of its glyphs. scripts/export-tokens.mjs merges
it into every step of the control piece of each tokens/glass.json variant; nk-widgets and
Hyalo's window controls read it there, and nowhere else. 'default' applies to every variant;
each entry of 'variants' then to those whose dark/reduceTransparency it names.
Every number is PROVISIONAL until the owner tunes it live in the native demo. Where each one
starts from: response.lumaLow/lumaHigh = the shell's ink thresholds (glass.json ink
lightBelow/darkAbove), the band the binary ink used to switch in; hover/press washes = the
kit's GLASS_STATE_MIX (hover 0.08/0.06, open 0.20/0.14); the destructive reds and the inks =
the window controls' own until now (render/controls.rs). The contrast band, the shadow's
gains and the two durations have no source yet.
